messages.speaker: Professor Chen
messages.text: After the second test, a normal mutation definitely appeared. Not after contact, not after an injection: after your moral decision.

messages.speaker: Professor Chen
messages.text: Its genome shifted at the exact moment you imagined the prisoner in front of the forbidden door. For now, the form remains healthy.

choices.label: Then we slow down. I refuse to push it without understanding.
We continue, but every hypothesis must be verifiable.
Show me the mutation. I want to see what I caused.

messages.speaker: Professor Chen
messages.text: This is the real dilemma. If your choices transform it, are you still a patient to protect or an actor responsible for its future?

choices.label: I take responsibility for the bond as long as it exists.
Command must decide. I am too involved.
The creature must have a sign to give, even an imperfect one.

messages.speaker: Professor Chen
messages.text: If it inherits your mental images, what should we do with your memories of Operation Mirador?

choices.label: Lock them away. Some memories are biological threats.
Analyze them slowly to separate fact, fear, and guilt.
Let them surface. What it is looking for may be inside.
